verseText: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.

mdText: And the twelve gates _were_ twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city _was_ pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

verseText: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
richText: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
mdText: And I saw no temple therein: for the [Lord]([/person/god_1324) God [Almighty]([/person/god_1324) and the [Lamb]([/person/jesus_905) are the temple of it.

verseText: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
richText: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
mdText: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of [God]([/person/god_1324) did lighten it, and the [Lamb]([/person/jesus_905) _is_ the light thereof.

verseText: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
richText: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
mdText: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

verseText: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
richText: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
mdText: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

verseText: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
richText: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
mdText: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

verseText: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
richText: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
mdText: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither _whatsoever_ worketh abomination, or _maketh_ a lie: but they which are written in the [Lamb’s]([/person/jesus_905) book of life.

verseText: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
richText: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
mdText: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of [God]([/person/god_1324) and of the [Lamb.]([/person/jesus_905)

verseText: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
richText: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
mdText: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, _was_ _there_ the tree of life, which bare twelve _manner_ _of_ fruits, _and_ yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree _were_ for the healing of the nations.

verseText: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
richText: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
mdText: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of [God]([/person/god_1324) and of the [Lamb]([/person/jesus_905) shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

verseText: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
richText: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
mdText: And they shall see his face; and his name _shall_ _be_ in their foreheads.

verseText: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
richText: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
mdText: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the [Lord]([/person/god_1324) God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

verseText: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
richText: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
mdText: And he said unto me, These sayings _are_ faithful and true: and the [Lord]([/person/god_1324) God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

verseText: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
richText: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
mdText: Behold, I come quickly: blessed _is_ he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

verseText: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
richText: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
mdText: And I [John]([/person/john_1677) saw these things, and heard _them._ And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.

verseText: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
richText: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
mdText: Then saith he unto me, See _thou_ _do_ _it_ not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship [God.]([/person/god_1324)

verseText: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
richText: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
mdText: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

verseText: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
richText: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
mdText: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

verseText: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
richText: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
mdText: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward _is_ with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

verseText: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
richText: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
mdText: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the [last.]([/person/god_1324)

verseText: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
richText: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
mdText: Blessed _are_ they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

verseText: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
richText: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
mdText: For without _are_ dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

verseText: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
richText: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
mdText: I [Jesus]([/person/jesus_905) have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the [root]([/person/jesus_905) and the offspring of [David,]([/person/david_994) _and_ the bright and morning star.

verseText: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
richText: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

verseText: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
richText: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
mdText: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, [God]([/person/god_1324) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

verseText: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
richText: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
mdText: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, [God]([/person/god_1324) shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and _from_ the things which are written in this book.

verseText: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
richText: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

verseText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
richText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
